description: This file defines a feature for listing tags in a C# application, including a request class, a request handler that fetches tags from the database, and a response envelope.
external_methods: Entity Framework Core methods: OrderBy, AsNoTracking, ToListAsync

classes.name: List.Query
classes.description: A request object implementing IRequest that queries for tags.

classes.name: List.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the Query to fetch tags from the database asynchronously and returns a TagsEnvelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the Query to retrieve tags from the database context asynchronously and wraps the result in a TagsEnvelope.
